title: Shulchan Arukh Yoreh Deah — Wikisource English 147 and 152 (partial)
attribution: Shulchan Arukh by Joseph Karo with Rema glosses; English translations by Wikisource contributors. See source-manifest.json for pinned revisions and contributor histories. CC BY-SA 4.0.
changes: Selected paragraphs from two source revisions, removed page navigation and interleaved Hebrew, combined adjacent English paragraphs, and escaped text for the reader. Adapted text remains CC BY-SA 4.0.
scope: Selected sections from Wikisource revisions created in 2025: 147:1–5 and 152:1–2. Some Rema material is omitted, including the glosses on 147:5 and 152:2. Translation was checked against adjacent Hebrew but not independently proofread; source history does not establish the translation method.
